outlook.statement: The Company remains focused on building a sustainable, profitable, and digitally agile organization, with emphasis on operational efficiency, financial discipline, technology adoption, customer engagement, and people development.

The Indian textile industry has expanded to nearly US$190 billion during FY 2025-26 and has set an ambitious target of reaching US$350 billion by 2030, supported by investments in capacity expansion, technical textiles, sustainability, and enhanced export competitiveness.
The global textile market was valued at approximately USD 1.16 trillion in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 1.61 trillion by 2033, reflecting a CAGR of around 4.2%.
Ministry of Textiles estimates India's technical textiles sector to achieve a remarkable ~11% CAGR over FY25-FY30 to USD 54bn from ~USD 26bn estimated in FY25.
The Economic Survey 2025-26 projected real GDP growth of 6.8%–7.2% for FY 2026-27, indicating continued expectations of sustained economic expansion.

The likely increase in capital mobilisation from the primary market, increase in resource mobilisation by mutual funds and phenomenal growth in secondary market volumes provide significant business opportunities for the Company.
